verdict_text:
NO

The plan commits exactly the ordering hazard the specification warns about: the second task vector is taken against a base that the first merge has already modified. After the `add_` at step 4, `base::...mlp.*` holds `b + 0.4(f1-b)`; the subsequent `subtract_` therefore yields `tv2 = f2 - (b + 0.4(f1-b))`, so the output is `b + 0.4(f1-b) + 0.4(f2-b) - 0.16(f1-b)` instead of the formula required by "Required result" clause 2 (each task vector must be `ft - base` against the unmodified base) — an error far above the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance. Additionally, the "Required checks" bullet "exactly 48 tensors were merged" is not implemented: there is no count assert on the set of MLP tensors (or on the intermediate `tv1`/`tv2` set) anywhere in the plan, only the 114-count checks on the three checkpoints.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
